title: Gridmesh - save preview image as PNG
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.1

4.6: Tested in 4.6 and the outcome and workaround are the same as I described.
1 thing in 4.6 is different: I did not have to first make it unique, I could immediately save the preview as a PNG.

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

When I make an item in the mesh library of Gridmap unique (because otherwise I can’t save the preview image) and then save the preview image as PNG, the gridmap does not work anymore as intented: all blocks disappear as soon as you press F5 of F6 to test the game.

Note: when you save the preview image as TRES, the blocks don't disappear at run time.
But as soon as I save the preview image as PNG, the blocks disappear at run time.

Note 2: when I save and reload the project, the blocks don't disappear at run time, so maybe reloading the project is a workaround.

In the attached project, I already exported the image of the preview image from items 0, 1, 2, 3 and maybe 4.

### Steps to reproduce

- Export a 3D node with 2 or more blocks (Meshinstance3d>StaticBody3d>CollisionShape3D) as mesh library.
- Attach to the tree node a GridMap and include the just exported mesh library.
- Make the preview of an item in the mesh library of Gridmap unique (because otherwise I can’t save the preview image) 
- Save the preview image as PNG

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godotcraft_(copy)_(copy)_2026-01-30_12-56-33.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24964304/godotcraft_.copy._.copy._2026-01-30_12-56-33.zip)
